faqs.question: Is it difficult to get into MBA at Dr BR Ambedkar University, Kashmere Gate?
faqs.answer:
No, candidates can easily get admission for MBA at Dr BR Ambedkar University, Kashmere Gate since the selection criteria is national-based entrance exam score such as CUET-PG and CMAT. Aspirant need to meet the last educational qualifications, i.e., Graduation with 50% aggregate. Overall, it is a full-tim course and the total course fee is in between INR 2.1 Lacs to INR 2.5 lakh.

college_info.intro:
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi offers UG and PG courses across various streams such as Management, Design, Arts, Computer Application, and others. MBA, MA, and MDes are the flagship courses offered at the university.
BR Ambedkar University Delhi offers a full-time, two-year MBA at the PG level. The MBA programmes offered at the university cover core courses along with the eligibility criteria. The MA programme offered by the Baba Bhimrao Ambedkar University Delhi is a two-year programme. It is offered on several specialisations such as Political Science, Urban Studies, Criminology, English, History, Performance Studies, and others. reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with staff members.

review_content.Placements: About 15% of students are placed in this course. Student who got highest package in my course is 16 LPA, lowest package is 5 LPA, and average package is 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are financial institutions, consulting firms, tech companies, and research organizations. Almost 55% of students got internships at these companies. Roles offered are tax, interest rates, wealth, and inflation.
review_content.Infrastructure: Area of college is very large and this area is well organised. Infrastructure is developed and covered with Wi-Fi lanes. Classrooms are covered with smart screens. Library is also covered with Wi-Fi. Hostel provides a gym, library, and a good food facility. Campus also provides medical facilities and organizes sports meets.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Sociology - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, it is the best university for an M.A. in Sociology course.

review_content.Placements: About 89% of students got placed in our college. The highest package was 15 LPA, the lowest was 2 LPA, and the average package was almost 9 LPA. Top recruiters were Monk Prayogshala, Satyarthi, Anantics, etc. Almost 76% of students in my course got internships. Social researchers, sociologists, etc., were the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: New groups began before the previous ones finished their coursework. Leaving the new group without a classroom for approximately six months. Requiring them to stay in the library or the anatomy hall classroom. Laboratories possessed all the necessary tools and resources. You could contribute library books for as long as you wished. The interactive board wasn't functioning. The hostel was well-equipped.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Gender Studies - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Decent placement assistance with training and internship opportunities for all branches.

review_content.Placements: Students become eligible for placements from their 3rd year. Companies like Accenture and Cognizant had visited. The average salary was 6 LPA - 7 LPA. The highest package of this year was 44 LPA. 80% of students got placements in product-based companies, like Flipkart and Amazon.
review_content.Infrastructure: There were groups of classes of all the subjects in which all the notifications were given. There was a library in the university which had all the subjects and any other books apart from that. The campus was very big. There was room for games too. Campus and campus life were very good and happy.

reviews_list.batch_info: Discontinued (Oct 2024)- Bachelor of Business Administration- Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Venture Development (BBA-IEV) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: An insight into Ambedkar University, Delhi.

review_content.Placements: Placements at AUD are not at all good. We can expect to get decent internships with the help of the placement cell but not a job. Companies recruiting students are not very reputed rather they are the businesses from the Kashmere gate market itself. I once sat for an interview for an internship at a company that supplied car parts.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at AUD is great. Every classroom has an AC and a projector. There are three computer labs in total which can be accessed by students to access the internet or the computer to make a presentation or complete an assignment. All labs are air-conditioned. If students do not wish to use the computer lab, they can access the Wi-Fi on their laptops or tablets with the help of the faculty members at the computer lab. The library is also air-conditioned and is well-equipped with all the resources a student might need.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Development Studies - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: We have a partition museum in our college that helps us to understand the history.

review_content.Placements: Placements of the college had a good record. There was placement percentage of above 95%. Also, placement training was often given to the students. It helped students to keep themselves updated and adapt to the kind of interviews from the placement-perspective. The average placement package was 10 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: There were no sports in AUD. There were also online and offline libraries in AUD which helped us a lot in our dissertation period.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members were approachable, friendly, and ready to help all students in their respective fields about curriculum and career. Exams were conducted and made it difficult for students to involve themselves in other extra-curricular activities that might highly benefit their careers. Exams were easy to clear. The course curriculum was mostly relevant despite which some courses, especially labs were not in the current scenario.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in English - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Very expensive for a government college and satisfactory infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: The placement rate of the college is not very good. I have been hurt by the seniors that basically we are on our own. A few internships can be provided by the college during the tenure. Otherwise, there are no placements for subjects like M.A. English. The course is designed for students to understand the application of the English language in history economics, political science, human psychology, and human condition.
review_content.Infrastructure: College in terms of infrastructure is not at all viable. There is a lack of clean washrooms, pathetic maintenance of buildings, sufficient library, and absence of Wi-Fi are some of the many problems you will have to face here. The canteen is also very expensive. The college shares its only ground with another college IGDTU.

reviews_list.review_title: Review

review_content.Other: I will start with the admission procedure, for MBA in MANIT, you will be required to submit a valid CAT Score card with other educational documents of course. Irrespective of the percentile scored in CAT no matter what you have scored they will consider you until they have seats left in their old class rooms. In my session people got admission because there were seats available and they purchased the admission brochure. Now something about the studies, few teachers are very professional and have in-depth knowledge of their respective subjects and rest all will fool you with their experience. You have to study hard for good grades but if you just want to pass they will give you 2 to 3 chances of re-exams in which they will tell what you questions they will ask because they cannot throw any failure student out. For students with reservations they will have facilities of scholarships means fees refunds. Wi-Fi, projector, library, canteen and such other facilities are good enough means you can survive. They have SBI as there internship provider and they only choose 4-6 people in every batch. There are two conditions for selection either your educational background is good enough or you have made good relations with the teachers, seniors and most importantly people handling T&P Coordination jobs. No placement facility is provided from the college. Few stupid teachers will fool you that they can ensure your placement but they are struggling with their own jobs. As a bad carpenter blames his tools they will either blame you for not putting enough efforts in T&P Coordination or play a blame game with other teachers in the department. Students doing other courses from same college will have ample of opportunities but not particularly for this department. They will fool you with the pictures of few students who accidently got selected once in Coal India. Vardman yarns is the only company that keeps on coming every year and hire 3-5 people for the sake. Package will be 20k per month. Fees is less and the environment is quite good and your two years will pass quickly, writing tests and exams which will give you knowledge but no industry experience and no placements will make you feel a loser at the end. Few students with good relations with teachers or the people handling T&P Coordination might get few bullshit opportunities to feel proud on, rest all will only feel proud on having a degree from NIT.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The college is very good and affordable, and it is recommendable.

content.Placements: Placements are very good in SIMCA. Almost 80% of students got placed. The average salary package is 5 LPA, and the highest package is 15 LPA. For the 2019 batch, the lowest package is 3 LPA. CPC and TPC provide very good placements in every Sinhgad College.
content.Infrastructure: The college and hotel infrastructure is pretty good. They have a clean and eco-friendly environment. individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review of SIMCA - Sinhgad Institute of Management and Computer Application.

content.Placements: In the year 2020, I passed out from this college. I have suffered a lot in this college. Our college's non-teaching staff are very abusive, especially two accountants and public relations officer. Registrar tries to influence you with his sweet words, but do not get in their trap. Our college has annoyed me very much. Forget about placements, it is only a dream, which will never come true.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is old. There are black spots and cracks on the college buildings. The hostel has bunk beds, individual table racks, and chairs for every student in every room. Still, students disturb each other, and the tube lights in the corridor are broken, but no one bothers about it. MBA and Engineering students must have separate hostels or floors, but all are together. Food is provided two times a day in the mess, like 11 am, and 8 pm or 9 pm. Food quality is the best.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty.

content.Placements: In our college 90% students were placed in various campus drives. The highest package offered was 1 lack and minimum package was 10000 per month. Top Recruiting companies are accenture, cogzniant, Bitwise, Western union, etc. Top Roles offered in our course are Jr. Developer, Jr. Tester, Trainee, etc. The highest package was 12lpa, the lowest was 1.2pla and average package was 3.2lpa.
content.Infrastructure: In our course the facilities and infrastructure available are free Wi-Fi, cctv security, 5 computer labs, digital classrooms, 2 libraries, trained and polite staff, various events, our course dedicated building, free medicals, etc. Quality of the facilities in our hostel on an rating scale I would like to give 4 out of 5. the quality of food available in mess is 3 out of 5. Medical facility is available near campus free of cost. There are various events organised by our college for sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with good faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: About 50% of student got placed in MNC and Other companies. Different types of packages are offered to students. The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. The average salary offered ranges from Rs. 25,000-50,000 per month and the lowest salary offered ranges from Rs. 14,000-16,000 per month. In campus drive, top companies like Bitwise, TCS, etc., visited the campus.
content.Infrastructure: In my course, no of facilities are available like some online tutorials, youtube, some learning sites, online certification course, etc. Quality of food in the canteen is good, and mess are available outside the college and canteen is available.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The overall placement is low, but the faculty members and infrastructure facilities are good.

content.Placements: Overall, the placement is good. Most of the IT companies came for the marketing department, and their criteria for the placement is high. Companies like Capgemini, FMCG and retail companies visit the college, and they are equally good with the companies like Marico, ITC, Hindustan Unilever, etc. The minimum salary package is 1.8 LPA, the maximum is 4.2 LPA, and the average is 2.5 LPA, for my batch to date. About the internship, it is overall good, but most of the companies who visit the college are providing financial services and insurance, and the average stipend was around Rs.5,000. review_summary.college_name: SGGSCC Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good college for commerce students.

content.Placements: Most of the placements are from the B.Com Honors. Talking about the B.Com programme, there are fewer placements, but the average package is about 5 LPA-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Deloitte, EY, and KPMG, where nearly 50 percent of students got placement, and the top roles offered are in Audit.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. There is availability of Wi-Fi. There are around 4-5 labs on campus, and many classrooms. There is a library a 3-floor library facility. Hostel is also good. The food is above average, sports room is also there, table tennis, badminton, and cricket are also available. The medical facilities are also available in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Off-campus diamond for commerce students

content.Placements: The placement opportunities provided in this college are very good. Companies generally come with an average package of 5 LPA, and about 70 percent of the total people who sit for the placements get placed every year. The companies are also of good profiles. Most of the roles are in finance, sales, and consulting.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is top-notch. There is a girls’ hostel available on the college premises, but for the boys, they have to find PGs and flats, which are readily available in the nearby areas. The college also provides various technological and sports facilities. The Wi-Fi is good too. The canteen provides various types of food options.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: SGGSCC- The hidden gem of DU.

content.Placements: There is a strong placement support cell at SGGSCC, which helps us prepare well for the interviews, resume vetting, and other grounds as well. The average package goes around 5 LPA-6 LPA only, the big-4 comes to our college as well, recruiting a lot of students.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best part about our college be it a 3-floor library, hostels, classroom, labs everything is on point. The only drawback is the Wi-Fi, even though it is there for students to connect but not as easily available. There are a few sections where there is no network in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. (Hons.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely satisfied with the college campus, the better placements every year, and good faculty

content.Placements: A lot of roles are offered in college placements. The college is one of the best when it comes to placements, as all of the Big 4 companies come every year to recruit students for roles like accountant or manager. Many other top companies also come to recruit students. All of the students who sit for placements usually get a job with an average package of ₹6-7 LPA, with the highest being around ₹24 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is absolutely amazing compared to other colleges of Delhi University. It has a fully air-conditioned campus with an auditorium that has a capacity of 1,000 people in an elevated format. It also consists of a Gurudwara made entirely of wood, and the buildings are also good with good furniture. There is no hostel available for boys, it is only available for girls with decent infrastructure and good service.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placement and infrastructure are good.

content.Placements: The student placement is more than 80%. The highest package is around 10 LPA, and the lowest is 3.25 LPA. Top recruiters are Deloitte, KPMG, EY, and PWC. Around 60% of students have been placed in internship. Top roles are audit, marketing, and consulting.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce is very Good. The college provides a girls hostel. The mess and infrastructure of the hostel are very Good. The hostel staff have taken good care of the safety of the girls in college.

Delhi University for all its affiliated colleges, such as Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce started considering CUET UG exam 2022 onward for admission to its UG courses. For postgraduate courses, DU-affiliated colleges will be considering CUET PG conducted by NTA starting 2023.

Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce admission process for UG or PG courses consists of six major steps which include registration for CUET UG or PG, appearance in the relevant exam, registration for DU CSAS, CSAS counselling process, merit list release and seat allocation.
The detailed admission process of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce is mentioned below:
Step 1: CUET Registration 2025

Prospective candidates looking to secure admission to UG & PG courses atSri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerceneed to apply online on the official website of CUET UG & CUET PG, respectively. The detailed CUET UG & CUET PG application process is given below:
Check the CUET UG application process in detail
Check CUET PG application process in detail
Step 2: Appear for the CUET exam
Candidates willing to get into Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, who have registered for CUET are required to appear for the exam in the subject of their choice and get a valid score.
Step 3: How to apply for Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce (DU) UG CSAS?
Candidates can check the step-by-step process mentioned below:
Step 1: Visit the official CSAS portal of DU, i.e., https://ugadmission.uod.ac.in/ and register as a new user.
Step 2: Fill out the preferences of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce and desired course combinations.
Step 3: There is a one-time CSAS 2025 application fee that students are required to pay. This fee is non-refundable.
CSAS (UG) - 2025 Application Fee
UR/OBC-NCL/EWS
NOTE:For applying to ECA and Sports supernumerary quota, there is an additional fee ofINR 100for each quota.
Step 4: CSAS Counselling Process
The Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce admission process after the CUET result declaration is explained below:

Step 4.1:After the declaration of the CUET UG exam, register on the DU CSAS portal in multiple phases. Submit Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce + Course combination preferences in the order of priority on the CSAS dashboard.

Step 4.2:Select"freeze"to confirm the admission choice. Once they select this option, they will not be considered for "upgradation" of choice in further rounds of CSAS. Candidates must only select this option only if they are satisfied with the allocated seat.

Step 4.3:Once the candidate "Accept" the provisionally allocated seat, the Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce will verify the eligibility and documents uploaded by the candidate online. Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce has an option to 'Accept' or 'Reject' the admission of the student basis the verification.
Step 5: Final Seat Confirmation by Students
Once Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce accords the approval, candidates will have to pay the 'Admission Fee' to confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for commerce students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. There is availability of Wi-Fi. There are around 4-5 labs on campus, and many classrooms. There is a library a 3-floor library facility. Hostel is also good. The food is above average, sports room is also there, table tennis, badminton, and cricket are also available. The medical facilities are also available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Off-campus diamond for commerce students
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is top-notch. There is a girls’ hostel available on the college premises, but for the boys, they have to find PGs and flats, which are readily available in the nearby areas. The college also provides various technological and sports facilities. The Wi-Fi is good too. The canteen provides various types of food options.

reviews.review_heading: SGGSCC- The hidden gem of DU.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best part about our college be it a 3-floor library, hostels, classroom, labs everything is on point. The only drawback is the Wi-Fi, even though it is there for students to connect but not as easily available. There are a few sections where there is no network in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I'm absolutely satisfied with the college campus, the better placements every year, and good faculty
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is absolutely amazing compared to other colleges of Delhi University. It has a fully air-conditioned campus with an auditorium that has a capacity of 1,000 people in an elevated format. It also consists of a Gurudwara made entirely of wood, and the buildings are also good with good furniture. There is no hostel available for boys, it is only available for girls with decent infrastructure and good service.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce is very Good. The college provides a girls hostel. The mess and infrastructure of the hostel are very Good. The hostel staff have taken good care of the safety of the girls in college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a dream college for every student.
reviews.review_text: This college is very large and has excellent Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities in the hostel is also very good. The classrooms are clean, and the furniture is in good condition. The library provides Wi-Fi, with a strong connection, and offers a wide range of resources. The college features various sports facilities, including a football ground and cricket fields, catering to all the needs of students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good with good infrastructure, and teachers are well qualified.
reviews.review_text: The Hostel is good with all the facilities. Our college has only a girls hostel. They take good care of the safety of the girls. There are 2 wardens in the hostel for the care of the girls. The hostel is under the surveillance of a CCTV camera.

reviews.review_heading: A good college of Delhi University is so underrated.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are Wi-Fi, AC classroom, and AC in the library which has 3 floors full space of sitting and availability of books, canteen, and good infrastructure. Talking about the hostel, all the necessities are provided in hostel good food in a mess with a 3-time meal.

reviews.review_heading: I am blessed to be in this college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are very well furnished. Everything is up to date, and fully new, and we never feel like it's an old building. There is too much greenery in our college, almost half of the college is covered with plants and trees. The hostel facility is not for NCWEB students because only Delhi-based girls can take admission, but for regular students, there is a hostel in our college, which is very beautiful and peaceful. The canteen food is also good. Every year, there is an annual sports d...

reviews.review_heading: It is a very above average college.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection can be a little bad sometimes but the other infrastructure is really great. Washrooms are very clean. Classrooms are air-conditioned and the water supply is good and clean. Library and labs are very well managed. But in hostels, the food cooked can be somewhat better, except for that the hostel rooms are nice and clean to reside in.

reviews.review_heading: Placements, the infrastructure, the quality of students, and the faculty are all good.
reviews.review_text: Since our college is comparatively new, its infrastructure is really good. There are four blocks in total, which comprise classes for different courses. We have a huge auditorium, a basketball ground, and a smaller football ground. We have AC here. I can’t say on the hostel since there is only a girls' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce has one of the best crowds and societies in DU.
reviews.review_text: The library in our college is awesome and the best library in DU after SRCC. Classrooms are great, with centralized AC all over the campus and the canteen also provides good and clean hygienic food and the food is even very delicious. The campus is also clean.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great experience.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on the college campus, but on the 3rd floor, it doesn't work properly. Labs are on the ground as well as the first floor, and all labs are well maintained and updated from time to time for students. The food available in the canteen is average, not so good, not so bad.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth of money. The crowd is good, faculty is helpful, and infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on the campus, not all around the college. It works well in some areas like in the canteen. There are labs on the ground floor and first floor. There are 3 or 4 labs in the college to assist them in practising for practical exams. These labs are well-maintained. The library is very big with a lot of course books which can be issued to students. There's also a space for students to sit and study in the library. The food is okay. It is not very good. It is like other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: SGGSCC - king of all campuses.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in SGGSCC is top-notch and one of the best in Delhi University. All classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and projectors. The library also has an RFID system which is very helpful for tracking books. The college also has well-managed labs for commerce. The college also has a badminton court, Gurudwara, volleyball court, basketball court and hostel for girls.

review_summary.college_name: SSIU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It provides good placements and good vibes for studies.

content.Placements: It does excellent work and places students. There is a very good environment in college areas. 92% of students are eligible for placements in B.Sc. IT. Many students get good packages in their courses. Students have a great platform for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The college has its own personal Wi-Fi and labs for students. Classrooms are very big and attractive for students who come from other cities and states. It has a nice school structure. The hostel, mess, and medical facilities are good. The campus has good vibes for outer students. The infrastructure of the college is very good. It has good vibes.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Reasonable academics, but lacks industry focus, poor infrastructure, and limited placements.

content.Placements: As a B.Pharma student, only 10% of us got placed, with packages ranging from Rs 2 LPA - Rs 6 LPA. Local companies dominate placements and internships, with only 5% getting internship opportunities. The college needs better industry exposure and placement support.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is poor, with overcrowded hostels housing 5 students per room and visible wall cracks. Labs are average, though medical labs are slightly better. The library is decent. Sports activities are inactive, and medical assistance is slow to respond.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: An average college for those who want just a degree.

content.Placements: 30-40% of students were placed in my course. They market 40 LPA as the highest package, but talking to some of my seniors, there are no such packages offered. Local companies recruit; they market themselves like big companies coming for recruitment, but I haven't witnessed that.
content.Infrastructure: The situation is very poor: no proper Wi-Fi and no proper system; they still use Windows 7, with broken mice and keyboards. The library is much better, having been renovated this year. The hostel quality was very poor, but it has improved. The canteen, medical facility, and sports and games are average.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA Hons) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Affordable but lacks practical learning and industry exposure: average infrastructure and events.

content.Placements: Around 40% of students are placed. The highest package was 5 LPA, the lowest was 1.8 LPA, with an average around 2.5 LPA. A few internships are offered in small firms, with roles mostly in sales, support, or trainee positions. The top recruiters are limited; overall, the placement scenario is average but consistent.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has decent Wi-Fi, average labs, and basic classrooms. The library is small but functional. Hostel rooms need maintenance, mess food is repetitive, and the sports facilities are limited. Medical help is available, but response time is slow. The hostel rooms are very small and have to be shared with 5 people, which is not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and campus life, but the curriculum needs an update.

content.Placements: About 85% of students from my batch get placed, with the highest package at 18 LPA, the lowest at 3.5 LPA, and an average of 6.5 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Accenture, and Capgemini. Around 70% get internships in firms like Wipro and Deloitte.
content.Infrastructure: The department offers modern labs, fast Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean and decent, the mess food is average, and there are good medical facilities. The campus also has sports grounds for cricket, badminton, and more.

paragraphs: The Swarrnim Startup and Innovation University placements for 2024 recorded a highest domestic package of INR 84 LPA . The highest international package offered stood at INR 48 LPA . More than 400 companies took part in the placements and offered over 2600 jobs .

Earlier, the University witnessed the participation of 400 companies during 2023 placements. The average package offered during Swarrnim Startup and Innovation University placements 2023 was INR 5.18 LPA . Further, the highest domestic package and highest international package stood at INR 30 LPA and INR 48 LPA , respectively.

The Training and Placement cell at SSIU started Campus to Corporate Program (CTCP) that offers the students' overall development. The students are placed in MNC's and various industries like Service Based, Product Based, Pharmaceutical, IT, FMCG, banking, insurance, hospitality, agriculture, etc.

faqs.question: What are the fees structures for MBA programmes at SSIU?
faqs.answer: Approximately 1.3 Lacs is the yearly fee for the standard MBA programme. There would be a yearly tuition fee of around 1.5 Lacs for various specialisations, such as the MBA in Healthcare Management and the MBA in Family Business Management. Every year, this charge will change. If a student chooses to live on campus, there will be fees for the mess and hostel. Scholarships based on merit are provided by SSIU to exceptional applicants accepted into the MBA programme. Your academic standing and admission exam results determine how much of the scholarship you receive. For students who can prove they are financially struggling, SSIU also provides need-based scholarships.Financial statements and evidence of income are among the paperwork required when applying for a need-based scholarship.

hostel_campus.college_name: SSIU Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: It provides good placements and good vibes for studies.
reviews.review_text: The college has its own personal Wi-Fi and labs for students. Classrooms are very big and attractive for students who come from other cities and states. It has a nice school structure. The hostel, mess, and medical facilities are good. The campus has good vibes for outer students. The infrastructure of the college is very good. It has good vibes.

reviews.review_heading: Reasonable academics, but lacks industry focus, poor infrastructure, and limited placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor, with overcrowded hostels housing 5 students per room and visible wall cracks. Labs are average, though medical labs are slightly better. The library is decent. Sports activities are inactive, and medical assistance is slow to respond.

reviews.review_heading: An average college for those who want just a degree.
reviews.review_text: The situation is very poor: no proper Wi-Fi and no proper system; they still use Windows 7, with broken mice and keyboards. The library is much better, having been renovated this year. The hostel quality was very poor, but it has improved. The canteen, medical facility, and sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable but lacks practical learning and industry exposure: average infrastructure and events.
reviews.review_text: The campus has decent Wi-Fi, average labs, and basic classrooms. The library is small but functional. Hostel rooms need maintenance, mess food is repetitive, and the sports facilities are limited. Medical help is available, but response time is slow. The hostel rooms are very small and have to be shared with 5 people, which is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and campus life, but the curriculum needs an update.
reviews.review_text: The department offers modern labs, fast Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean and decent, the mess food is average, and there are good medical facilities. The campus also has sports grounds for cricket, badminton, and more.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good course curriculum and placements. It lacks practical exposure.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities and infrastructure are available in the college. It has fast Wi-Fi, powerful labs, the best classrooms, the best library, and the best hostel. The food quality is average. Medical facilities, sports, and games are available specially for students. The environment of my college is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Only for certification.
reviews.review_text: There's no Wi-Fi, but yes, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with a separate library for engineering & medical sides. There's a big cricket ground, football ground, tennis court, badminton court, and a proper full-fledged medical ward/hospital. For engineers, there are 2 different computer labs: Windows lab & Apple lab. A separate seminar room is also available. It's equipped with almost everything a student wishes for. And there's a good canteen too.

reviews.review_heading: College with Apple labs and incubation center for innovative ideas.
reviews.review_text: We have a Wi-Fi campus, and it's only available in labs and libraries. My college has Apple labs and computer labs. We also have an incubation center where we can give our inventions or innovative ideas. We have an incubation cell for innovative ideas, and we also get capital if our idea is good. The food is much better. We have free Wi-Fi available in the hostel. There is a Bed and a separate river for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: After all, if you are a person who is easy.
reviews.review_text: Every facility seems pretty decent and I have no complaints regarding it. Everything works perfectly fine for me in the uni premises. Hostel rooms have a total capacity of 5 people per room allotment and yes it is very good , no problem at my end.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Arihant School of Pharmacy and Bio-research Institute.
reviews.review_text: In our college, all classrooms had air-conditioning. All facilities were available in labs. Both the gas line and water supply were properly installed. In our college library, all types of books were available for knowledge gain. There were various types of references available. The food served in the canteen was good and healthy.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: The quality of food was so good in the canteen. There was a good environment for education.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-equipped labs, 24X7 Wi-Fi, an incubation center, and a library with more than 5000 books. There are air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned hostels with 4 and 5 sharing rooms. Our college has playgrounds for cricket, football, and a swimming pool. Apple lab is available. It has a hygienic mess, pure drinking water facilities in the hostel and college, and a cafeteria with reasonable food items.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its education system.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are good but air-conditioners are not available. We also have a library for specific B.E and B.Tech students. There is a medical campus, and doctors are also available. There is a hospital that provides free medicines and services. Sports activities are also conducted in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is best for the B. Pharmacy study.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure is very good. It provides a clean class, laboratories, and libraries are also very useful and all books and references are available. In our college canteens is very good, and the food quality is excellent. The medical facilities are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with faculty members and college authorities.
reviews.review_text: All labs have medium-level facilities. There is no Wi-Fi facility. The classrooms are good and huge with some good facilities. The library is awesome. I have no idea about hostel facilities. The quality of food served is the best in the canteen area. Medical facilities are good 24 hours. The sports area is separate, and all types of games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Imperial school of banking and management studies.
reviews.review_text: Full amenities with luxury and good quality food with proper hygiene and full familiar take care and medical facilities. This provides and takes good care of an individual. There is also safety and provides Wi-Fi, housekeeping, and other supportive services.

reviews.review_heading: The Imperial School prioritizes holistic education for student growth and development.
reviews.review_text: The Imperial School of Banking and Management Studies provides more than just academic excellence. With its modern infrastructure, comfortable PG accommodations, and nutritious catering services, the campus offers a comprehensive learning experience. The college is dedicated to ensuring the well-being of its students.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members, learnings, and average placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: During my time, college was not that good but now they have shifted their entire college to another location and that is really good. College doesn't have its own hostel, and students live in local PG which is kind of affordable and good in that location (Hinjewadi Phase 1).

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Imperial.
reviews.review_text:
The college has modern classrooms with Wi-Fi, libraries, seminar halls, and sports grounds.
The college does not provide hostel facilities. Students have the option to go for PGs. The quality of facilities in PG is good. The quality of food is also good in PG.

reviews.review_heading: Outstanding placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: ISBMS provides well designed and spacious classrooms. Students can enjoy meals and high tea at the cafeteria. The campus also includes library, seminar halls, personal assistance and much more. ISBMS provides various sports amenities like playgrounds and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Nice environment,  100% placement, good infrastructure, and facility .
reviews.review_text: The quality of the hostel facility is good; the food is also good. They have sports games like we have a gym, sports club in our college. The college provides Wi-Fi, a game zone, classrooms, library, and a nice environment, available canteen facilities, personal rooms, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Industry oriented knowledge sharing.
reviews.review_text: Good library with many books for reading and area to sit. Availability of Wi-Fi and digital technology. Good campus area. Well-equipped classrooms and ground available. Provides indoor games activities. Sports and games activities like cricket, chess, carrom are enjoyed and initiated by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Best Directors and faculty members, Highly satisfied.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The college doesn't have a hostel, but the college has tie-ups with PG services nearby. We have great classrooms with a beautiful library followed by a games room, seminar hall, etc. The college has Wi-Fi, labs, and other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely happy because of quality of roles offered for placements and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts well-equipped classrooms featuring projectors and a library. The event management team, along with the students, organizes engaging games and activities. Additionally, the college hosts remarkable events, festivals, and activities that foster confidence and encourage students to express themselves.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts excellent infrastructure, offering students access to a well-equipped library and Wi-Fi enabled classrooms. Although there is currently no provision for food within the college premises, the administration is open to the possibility of establishing a canteen based on the students' needs. Additionally, the college takes the initiative to organize various sports and games activities. All in all, the overall infrastructure is commendable.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with very good placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not available in our college so students need to stay in PG. Many PGs are available near our college at affordable rates that serve meals 3 times a day and provide free Wi-Fi and electricity. Our college has a canteen that provides tea, coffee, snacks, and many more. Library is available where students can study in silence.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Imperial is good.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts excellent infrastructure offering students a conducive learning environment. It provides Wi-Fi facilities, a good library, and awesome classrooms. It doesn't provide its own hostel, but students have the option of staying in a PG. The quality of food in the PG is also good. The college also has sports equipment.

paragraphs: TKM Institute of Management admissionsare entrance-based. The institute considers national or state-level Management entrance exams such as CAT, KMAT, etc. for admission.TKMIMoffers MBA (Dual Specialisation) for two years in full-time mode. Interested candidates can apply online or download the application form for offline submission.

Candidates must fulfil both eligibility and selection requirements to get admission. Aspirants need to fill out the application form to participate in the selection rounds. Below are the steps to get a seat in the institute:
Step 1: TKM Institute of Management Application Process 2025

The mode of application is both online and offline. Candidates need to fill out personal, academic and contact details in the application form. Aspirants have to upload marksheet and entrance exam scorecards in the form. Candidates have to pay an application fee of INR 500 to register for a course.
Step 2: Selection

The institute selects candidates based on entrance exam scores. TKM Institute of Management accepts CMAT, CAT or KMAT scores. Selected candidates have to further participate in group discussion and personal interview round.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Once selected, candidates receive an admission offer. Selected aspirants have to payTKM Institute of Management feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at TKM Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: TKM Institute of Management admissions are entrance-based. The institute shortlists candidates based on entrance exam scores. TKM Institute of Management accepts CMAT, CAT or KMAT scores. Selected candidates have to further participate in group discussion and personal interview round for final admission.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in TKM Institute of Management without KMAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, KMAT is one of the entrance exams accepted for MBA admission at TKM Institute of Management. However, it is not mandatory. Aspirants with a valid score in CAT or CMAT can also get admission provided they also fulfil the eligibility requirements. Selected candidates are further required to pass GDPI for admission.

faqs.question: Is entrance exam compulsory for admission at TKM Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates need to pass any of the accepted entrance exam for admission at TKM Institute of Management. The institute selects candidates for admission based on CAT, CMAT or KMAT scores. The institute gives 80% weightage to the entrance exam scores of the candidate. Shortlisted aspirants have to further pass the GDPI round for final admission.

faqs.question: Can I direct admission at TKM Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: No, TKM Institute of Institute of Management does not offer direct admission under regular cycle. Candidates need have a valid score in CAT, CMAT or KMAT for admission to the MBA course. The first level of selection is based on entrance exam scores. Further, aspirants need to participate in the selection rounds for admission.

placement_data.title: TKM Institute of Management Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: TKM Institute of Mana has a Corporate Relations Cell (CRC) that helps in shaping the careers of students from their induction and orientation, summer internships, mid-term projects, right to their final placements and even beyond. CRC also undertakes various academic and non-academic initiatives so that students are well equipped to meet varied industry requirements. The Cell also networks with the institution’s alumni to create more career opportunities.

Recently, TKM Institute of Management has concluded the placements for its MBA batch passed out in 2024 . As per the latest report, the highest and average package offered during TKM Institute of Management placements 2024 stood at INR 16.2 LPA and INR 5.1 LPA, respectively. A total of 42 recruiters visited the TKM Institute of Management campus for 2024 placements and offered 54 job offers to the students of the MBA batch 2024. Additionally, 8 students received multiple job offers during the TKM Institute of Management MBA placements 2024. The top recruiters of TKM Institute of Management in 2024 included Grant Thornton, ITC, CSB Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Securities, Van Huesen, JBL, Asian Paints, EY, TCS, Airtel, KPMG, Berger Paints , etc.

admission_process.title: HRIT University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: HRIT University admissions are open currently. Candidates can check below the steps to get a seat in the university:
1. Application Process
Aspirants can apply on the official website of university. Candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 for a course.
2. Selection

The university reviews the application form of the candidates to confirm their eligibility. HRIT University conducts HRIT HNAT Test to select candidates for admission. Besides, the university also accepts scores in UGAT, PG Admission Test conducted by AKTU, GPAT, etc. for specific courses.
3. Counselling & Admission Confirmation

Aspirants selected based on PG Admission Test of AKTU are offered seats via counselling. For all other courses, candidates receive an email about their selection. Candidates need to report at the campus with the documents and pay theHRIT University feesto confirm their seat. Check below the documents required at the time of admission:
lists: Original Allotment Letter (if this seat is allotted via counselling)
Migration Certificate (if not passed Class 12 from UP Board)
Affidavit in case of any gap in study
Caste Certificate for SC, ST, OBC only
Graduation/ diploma marksheets of all years

review_summary.college_name: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Solapur University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of the SVERI Institute.

content.Placements: 50 percent of students were placed, and 50 percent of students took admission for post-graduation through the GPAT NIPER examination. The starting package is about Rs. 3,00,000 - 4,00,000. Companies like TCS and TCMS provided placements. Activities related to placements, such as aptitude tests and mock interviews, were conducted weekly.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the college and institute is very good, as it has large classrooms, a laboratory for doing practicals, a seminar hall, a sports hall, a conference hall, an open amphitheater, etc. The library is also available for study, and it includes all books related to competitive exams, course books, and other personal development books.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college of pharmacy in Solapur.

content.Placements: Placements are average. From my batch, around 7-8 are placed in various companies. Companies like TCMS, TCS, Omega Healthcare, etc, visit our college for placements. Also, in 3rd year of the Bachelor's program, a one-year internship programme is compulsory, to gain outside knowledge for students.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is very bad. The rules and regulations of the hostel are too strict. They don't allow you to go outside for anything. They check your phones. There is no meaning of privacy in a hostel. In a small room, there are 7 girls. Common washrooms and toilets are very hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Very good choice if you want to get a bachelor's degree with low fees and other expenses.

content.Placements: Less than 50% of students get placed in my course, B.A. The highest package is around 5 LPA, the average is around 2.5 LPA, and the lowest is 1.8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS and other local and education-related companies. Around 30% of students get internships in college and other local education-related companies. The top roles are teacher and education counselor.
content.Infrastructure: There are facilities like a library, labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, bathrooms, and study areas. Hostel facilities include good and healthy food, a canteen, a first aid kit, a sports ground, good and clean rooms for students, and clean toilets. The quality of the food is the best and felt like you are eating what your mom makes for you.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is nice, and facilities are also nice. I recommend this college.

content.Placements: Here, 30 students were placed out of 40. Placement is average. Highest package is 12 LPA, and lowest package is 4 LPA. Here, some communication companies, such as Wipro, are listed. Students are given proper training of interviews. More students are placed by placement cell, which is nice.
content.Infrastructure: There are two hostels, one for first year and another for second year, third year, and final year. First-year hostel has common toilets, and other hostel has an attached bathroom. All things are properly worked. They have a separate girls' hostel and hot water 24 hours a day for batch.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty and good placements. Good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: My college is very good. About 95% of students got placed. The highest package is 40 LPA. Many top companies prefer to take interviews and select students in my college. I am honestly proud to be a part of this college.
content.Infrastructure: SVERI College of Engineering has a very nice and clean hostel. The infrastructure of the college is very good and nice. Many computer labs are available in college. The Wi-Fi connection is clear and no issues with that. The big library is available in my college.

review_summary.college_name: Rungta College, Bhilai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are good at teaching and experienced, very good placement are provide in college .

content.Placements: 60-70% of students were placed. The highest package offered in the course was of 48LPA , the average was 30LPA, and the lowest was 15LPA. TCS, tech main, RS pharma visited campus. 45-55 % got internship from ozone pharmaceuticals.
content.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi are provided, labs are clean and well organized, in library all books notes are available. Hostel quality is good, healthy food in mess, medical facilities are provided. On Saturday sports and games are held in college. quality of infrastructure of college is good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with our college education, helpful teachers, infrastructure, and placements.

content.Placements: Around 70-80% of students got placed in our course. The average salary package offered is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, etc. About 50% of students got placed in Capgemini, TCS, and Cognizant. Top roles offered in our course are software engineer trainee, junior software developer, junior software tester, full stack developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides all the required facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, well-ventilated classrooms, a library, a drinking water cooler, a garden, etc. The food served in the mess and canteen is very healthy and tasty. It provides various varieties of dishes. Our college has sports grounds.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of Rungta Group of Institutions, Bhilai.

content.Placements: For pharmacy students, the rate of placements is not that high compared to other courses. Companies that came for recruitment on our campus were local.
content.Infrastructure: The ambiance and environment of the hostel are excellent. Restrictions were the same for boys and girls in the hostel, so we never faced any discrimination. The hostel provides Wi-Fi.
content.Faculty: The course is designed in such a way that an average student can grasp the concepts, which is extremely beneficial to students. We never faced difficulties in understanding the course. We have had many real-world experiences, which are the most important part of any education system. There are eight semesters, each with two CTs.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with placements and dissatisfied with other activities.

content.Placements: About 90% of students got placements in reputed companies. The highest salary package offered is 15 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1.35 LPA. Infosys, Accenture, Wipro, Research Bhaskar, Genpact, etc., are top recruiters here. About 50% of students got internships from our college. Remaining students got internships from outside on their own source. Manager, research analyst, etc., roles are offered here.
content.Infrastructure: There is free Wi-Fi on the campus, classrooms, canteen, etc. The food served in the mess is awesome, and our college is famous in Bhilai for its mess. Our college has various sports grounds like football, basketball, etc. There are 2 canteens, one for Jains and another one for non-Jains. All types of food items/juices are available.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Our college surely helps students to get their dream job.

content.Placements: Almost 80-90% of the students got placed. The lowest salary package offered was 1.8 LPA, and the highest salary package offered was 6.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our college are Infosys, Mphasis, KEKA, etc. Almost 80% of the students got internships in companies like Mphasis, KEKA, etc. Top roles offered to the students are as a transaction processing officer, i.e., TPO, HR assistant, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All types of facilities are provided to make the college more comfortable for each student. They maintain their hygiene very well. The quality of food is very good. Good facilities are provided for students who have an interest in sports and games.

Only the candidates who meet the preset eligibility criteria and have a valid CMAT score can get admission to DDU Nadiad's MBA programme. Such candidates must register for the ACPC counselling to participate in the seat allocation. 50% of the total MBA seats are reserved by the university under the Management Quota. Admission criteria for these seats is at the university's discretion. The university may accept CAT or any other entrance exam score for admission to these seats.

faqs.question: Are there any government jobs that I can seek after completing B.Tech from DDU Nadiad?
faqs.answer: BTech graduates of DD University can seek a variety of career opportunities after BTech . Some common government job opportunities for BTech graduates are mentioned below: PSUs: Companies like BHEL, ONGC, NTPC, and GAIL recruit BTech graduates through competitive exams like GATE. Indian Engineering Services (IES): After completing BTech, students can appear for the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) conducted by the UPSC, which offers prestigious positions in various government departments. Defence Services: BTech graduates can join the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force through exams like the Combined Defence Services (CDS) or Technical Entry Schemes (TES). Railway Jobs: Indian Railways recruit engineers through the Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) for various technical positions. State Public Service Commissions: Various state governments conduct exams for Engineering roles in state departments.

review_summary.college_name: Hierank Business School Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: All about MBA in Hierank Business School.

content.Placements: In my MBA batch, around 80% of students got placed in decent companies. And the highest package offered was 3.6 LPA and the average package was 2.4 LPA. Mostly the companies coming for hiring are the startups and the offered roles are mostly for sales, marketing, and human resources. Around 50% of the students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Hierank Business School, Noida, is not so big. There is just a building for the students with the little park inside and one canteen, which offers only samosas and cold drinks and sometimes you can get ice cream but their behavior was good. And there were no hostel facilities for the students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The placement percentage ratio of the college is around 60 percent. Only students with skills get placed. The highest package is 6 lakhs per annum and the lowest is 2.5 lakhs per annum. Companies like Wipro and HCL come for placements and hire good students.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good classrooms, a good library and good computer labs. It also has wifi and air conditioning in the rooms. The college also has a good canteen. I especially like the library. It is well-stocked with books and has comfortable seating. The computer labs are well-equipped and the wifi is reliable. The classrooms are spacious and well-lit. The canteen serves a variety of food and drinks.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My experience with Hierank business school.

content.Placements: The placement process is still ongoing; there are multiple companies offering internships for better understanding of the course. The highest package I've heard students get is 5 to 6 lacs. Wipro, TCS, and others are the top recruiters. Almost 80% of students apply for an internship and get it.
content.Infrastructure: Campus is good only for studying. If you have other interests like sports and activities, there is no place enough for that. Lecture halls get so hot during the summer that it's unbearable. The canteen in college is quite good for the prices they charge. And the food tastes good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Hierank Business School.

content.Placements: The students that were placed are likely to be above 50%. The highest package is around 600000 per annum and the average package is around 300000. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, Amazon, Deloitte, Infosys, etc. The students that got internships from the course and in companies are above 85%.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not good because the lecture rooms get cheated during the summer. The library is good for studies, but there are no novels or other literature books. The food in the canteen is good, and sports are held every day for practicing in tournaments.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good College for Those Students Who Don't Want to Spend More on UG Program

reviews.review_heading: All about MBA in Hierank Business School.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Hierank Business School, Noida, is not so big. There is just a building for the students with the little park inside and one canteen, which offers only samosas and cold drinks and sometimes you can get ice cream but their behavior was good. And there were no hostel facilities for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good classrooms, a good library and good computer labs. It also has wifi and air conditioning in the rooms. The college also has a good canteen. I especially like the library. It is well-stocked with books and has comfortable seating. The computer labs are well-equipped and the wifi is reliable. The classrooms are spacious and well-lit. The canteen serves a variety of food and drinks.

reviews.review_heading: My experience with Hierank business school.
reviews.review_text: Campus is good only for studying. If you have other interests like sports and activities, there is no place enough for that. Lecture halls get so hot during the summer that it's unbearable. The canteen in college is quite good for the prices they charge. And the food tastes good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Hierank Business School.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good because the lecture rooms get cheated during the summer. The library is good for studies, but there are no novels or other literature books. The food in the canteen is good, and sports are held every day for practicing in tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: Good College for Those Students Who Don't Want to Spend More on UG Program
reviews.review_text: The college provides average infrastructure, especially for IT students. The classrooms are good for studying, though the Wi-Fi network connection is low. The library is good and has a wide range of books available for all courses. The lab is fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: My overall experience in this college is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is okay; they don't have enough space for sports activities inside the campus. Sports activities are very good because we get the opportunity to play against other colleges in tournaments that are held by the colleges. The ratio of girls to boys in this college is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Glimpse of Hierank Business School .
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of our college is quite small but it contains all the necessary things. There is a fully furnished AC room for MBA students.
They also provide Wi-Fi facilities for the students. 
There is a library in which all the mandatory books are available .

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is fine; it is neither too big nor too small. The faculty members of the college are very professional and experienced and the method of teaching is also very good. There is no hostel in the college, but there is a small canteen where sports and games are also held.

reviews.review_heading: It is not a good college for sports.
reviews.review_text: Our college offers 3 courses such as BCA, BBA, and MBA. Classrooms provided for BCA and BBA students are average, but the classrooms for MBA students are good. Our college has a ground to play volleyball and a court for badminton.

reviews.review_heading: College life depends on students.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi available in our college is good. Our campus is good. Sports are not up to the mark because the playground is not sufficient to play games and sports. Library consists of course books and it should be improved. The canteen food is good. Our college tries to provide the best facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty members and  good environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There are two computer labs with almost 100 working computers. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. An indoor games room, badminton court, volleyball court and a canteen are available. The prices are minimal. There is a library with many books, and the college provides syllabus-related books.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is not so big but it is good for study purposes.
reviews.review_text: No hostel is available in our college but canteen food quality is quite better. I gave it 4 stars out of 5. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, sports ground, walking parks, labs, libraries, canteen, dance room, activity hall, and many more things are available in our course.

reviews.review_heading: Hierank is the best college for UG course and the mentors are very well behaved and polite.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very small for a college. It has a building comprising of a library, sports room, and computer labs. Each floor has computer labs which have many computers. It also has Wi-Fi access. The college provides free books to every student every semester which students have to return once the semester gets completed.

reviews.review_heading: Kind of disappointed by the college and I wished a more fun and exciting college life than this.
reviews.review_text: There are no air-conditioners in undergraduate classes. Classes are of an average size that can accommodate up to 50 students. We have 2 computer labs in which 30% of computers do not work. The library is the only place we students can sit and study in peace. The canteen is of no use. review_summary.college_name: Vishveshwarya Group of Institutions (VGI) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: About Visvesvaraya Group of Institutions.

content.Placements: A total of 81 percent of students got placed in my course. The highest package in my course is 21 LPA, and the lowest package is 5 LPA. The top recruitment companies in my course are Microsoft, Google, etc. A total of 91 percent of students got an internship in my course. The top roles offered in the course are the Manager post.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, full speed, and 24/7 availability. Labs are very big and well-cleaned and ventilated. Classrooms are also good and clean. A well-stocked library is present with all resources. The quality of facilities in my hostel is acceptable. The quality of food is good in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities and sports are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The name of my college is Vishveshwarya Group of Institutions.

content.Placements: I liked this college, I am doing B.A. here, and I liked the infrastructure here very much. The studies here are also very good, with a lot of internships. I am doing BBA from here, and it has taken me one year to do this course. It is very good to come here, and 60 percent is required for interns.
content.Faculty: Faculty members of our college are very helpful, like giving important notes during exam time or giving experience to interns when they come here. The faculty here is very respectable, sometimes they ask about a topic, and I studied it well in class. Since I came to this college, I have enjoyed studying a lot.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has decent academic support with a good campus. It needs more practical exposure.

content.Placements: Around 60-70% of students from the B.Tech course get placed. The highest package offered is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. The average package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include NGOs, media houses, and educational firms. Around 50% of students got internships in companies like Teach for India, Times Group, and local startups. Common roles offered are content writers, research assistants, and HR trainees.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good facilities for our department, including smart classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and well-equipped computer labs. The library is quiet and stocked with useful study materials. Hostels are clean and have basic amenities. The food in the mess is average. The canteen offers a better variety. Medical help is available on campus with a health center. Sports facilities, such as a playground and indoor games, are provided to encourage students' recreation. Overall, the infrastructure is decent and supports both academics and student life well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best college, if you are financially not that well.

content.Placements: This is a good college, if you want to grow you can grow here, and professors help in guiding for placements. The job fair was organized last year and many juniors were also given some internships so as to keep on learning and practicing. It helps to understand a student to know about the scene of the interviewing room.
content.Infrastructure: We have good infrastructure, Wi-Fi availability, classrooms are good, and proper hygiene is maintained. We have two libraries where more than 10 personal computers are there to learn and search things. High-speed internet is there all around the campus which is easily accessible.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review in the Shiksha by Rishabh Kaushik.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students got placed in top companies. The highest package offered for this course was 10 LPA. Many top companies visited for recruitment. Percentage of students got internships in this college was more than 90%.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities were available in this course. The food quality in my college was so good.
content.Faculty: Teachers in my college were so helpful and qualified. All were so knowledgeable, and they had great teaching quality. This course was not curriculum relevant, and students were industry-ready. Semester exams in this course were so easy. The pass percentage was 60%.

reviews.review_text: The available facilities of my college are WiFi, library, classroom, computer labs, sports ground, and for mobile games, there is a gaming room, etc. The food and medical facilities are the best facilities of my college; there are sports tournaments in which cricket is the most entertaining part of our college.

Wifi, lab, canteen, proper library with all books available and smart classrooms are there in all classes. Regular practicals are provided and there is a very large class room. In the hostel, 2 fans, 3 almirahs, a big balcony, a bed, a window, wifi, and 2, 3, 4 and 1 all-seater are available.

4 times food is available, with different food every day.

reviews.review_heading: The real experience of the campus .
